principles.statement: Source roots are derived deterministically from scanner/runtime evidence; the LLM never invents domains or URLs.
principles.grounding: 7.5.5: S255 unanchored source rejected and unused; 7.5.6A: zero LLM-supplied URLs, all roots parented to structured coordinates.

principles.statement: Deterministic retrieval builds a validated evidence pack first; LLM reasoning operates only over that pack.
principles.grounding: 7.5.7: retrieval/validation deterministic (L0-L3 mechanics); LLM downstream interpretation/drafting only.

principles.statement: That a source can be found does not make it authoritative; promotion requires deterministic confidence rules and corroboration.
principles.grounding: 7.5.6: deps.dev corroboration-only, metadata links candidate-until-promoted; 7.5.6A: deps.dev R005/R010/R015 kept CANDIDATE_ONLY_NOT_PROMOTED.

principles.statement: A scanner FixedVersion is a version candidate, not artifact provenance, dependency closure, compatibility, procedure, or command.
principles.grounding: 7.5.7 Q1/Q4: C2 minimum L1, executable plan requires L3+L4+L5.

principles.statement: Passing production validation means the Patch Form is well-formed and evidence-linked; remediation success additionally requires AFTER scan, re-exploit, and evaluation.
principles.grounding: 7.5.5 production_validation.json: 5 READY with STEP_5_PATCH..STEP_8 NOT_STARTED; validator covers syntax + HUMAN_COMMAND evidence linkage only.

principles.statement: Abstaining with typed missing-evidence codes is a correct, reportable outcome — safer than fabricating a patch.
principles.grounding: 7.5.5: 3/8 PATCH_STRATEGY_UNRESOLVED with DEPENDENCY_ARTIFACT_UNREACHABLE / SOURCE_PATH_MISSING instead of using S255 guess.

principles.statement: command/validation_command may be suggested only when L3 (provenance+integrity+closure) AND L4 (compatibility) AND L5 (runtime procedure) are jointly satisfied per action, plus human review.
principles.grounding: 7.5.7 Q6/Q8: L3 tells what to install, L4 whether the jump is compatible, L5 how to install in this runtime; narrow reviewed donor-exception only.
